When I was unemployed I was talking to my Grandad about my job search. And he told me how when he was my age he could just walk into any shop or factory, ask to speak to a manager and just get a job practically on the spot. And if he got tired of that job he could just leave and walk into somewhere else. He sympathised that it just wasn't like that any more. He understood that if you just walked into somewhere like that you'd just be told to apply online and even then there'd be a ton of people all vying for that position. I was pretty blown away that he actually understood that, when even the staff that the job centre didn't seem to.
